datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Afghanistan administrative units. The classifications represent food insecurity severity phases (IPC 1-5) aggregated spatially and temporally for medium-term projections in 2014, with multiple scenarios provided for different time periods.
